name: NYPD Complaint Data Historic
description: This dataset includes all valid felony, misdemeanor, and violation crimes reported to the New York City Police Department (NYPD) from 2006 to the end of last year (2019). For additional details, please see the attached data dictionary in the ‘About’ section.

columns.name: CMPLNT_NUM
columns.description: Randomly generated persistent ID for each complaint

columns.name: CMPLNT_FR_DT
columns.description: Exact date of occurrence for the reported event (or starting date of occurrence, if CMPLNT_TO_DT exists)

columns.name: CMPLNT_FR_TM
columns.description: Exact time of occurrence for the reported event (or starting time of occurrence, if CMPLNT_TO_TM exists)

columns.name: CMPLNT_TO_DT
columns.description: Ending date of occurrence for the reported event, if exact time of occurrence is unknown

columns.name: CMPLNT_TO_TM
columns.description: Ending time of occurrence for the reported event, if exact time of occurrence is unknown

columns.name: ADDR_PCT_CD
columns.description: The precinct in which the incident occurred

columns.name: RPT_DT
columns.description: Date event was reported to police

columns.name: KY_CD
columns.description: Three digit offense classification code

columns.name: OFNS_DESC
columns.description: Description of offense corresponding with key code

columns.name: PD_CD
columns.description: Three digit internal classification code (more granular than Key Code)

columns.name: PD_DESC
columns.description: Description of internal classification corresponding with PD code (more granular than Offense Description)

columns.name: CRM_ATPT_CPTD_CD
columns.description: Indicator of whether crime was successfully completed or attempted, but failed or was interrupted prematurely

columns.name: LAW_CAT_CD
columns.description: Level of offense: felony, misdemeanor, violation

columns.name: BORO_NM
columns.description: The name of the borough in which the incident occurred

columns.name: LOC_OF_OCCUR_DESC
columns.description: Specific location of occurrence in or around the premises; inside, opposite of, front of, rear of

columns.name: PREM_TYP_DESC
columns.description: Specific description of premises; grocery store, residence, street, etc.

columns.name: JURIS_DESC
columns.description: Description of the jurisdiction code

columns.name: JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Jurisdiction responsible for incident. Either internal, like Police(0), Transit(1), and Housing(2); or external(3), like Correction, Port Authority, etc.

columns.name: PARKS_NM
columns.description: Name of NYC park, playground or greenspace of occurrence, if applicable (state parks are not included)

columns.name: HADEVELOPT
columns.description: Name of NYCHA housing development of occurrence, if applicable

columns.name: HOUSING_PSA
columns.description: Development Level Code

columns.name: X_COORD_CD
columns.description: X-coordinate for New York State Plane Coordinate System, Long Island Zone, NAD 83, units feet (FIPS 3104)

columns.name: Y_COORD_CD
columns.description: Y-coordinate for New York State Plane Coordinate System, Long Island Zone, NAD 83, units feet (FIPS 3104)

columns.name: SUSP_AGE_GROUP
columns.description: Suspect’s Age Group

columns.name: SUSP_RACE
columns.description: Suspect’s Race Description

columns.name: SUSP_SEX
columns.description: Suspect’s Sex Description

columns.name: TRANSIT_DISTRICT
columns.description: Transit district in which the offense occurred.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Midblock Latitude coordinate for Global Coordinate System, WGS 1984, decimal degrees (EPSG 4326)

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Midblock Longitude coordinate for Global Coordinate System, WGS 1984, decimal degrees (EPSG 4326)

columns.name: Lat_Lon
columns.description: Geospatial Location Point (latitude and Longitude combined)

columns.name: PATROL_BORO
columns.description: The name of the patrol borough in which the incident occurred

columns.name: STATION_NAME
columns.description: Transit station name

columns.name: VIC_AGE_GROUP
columns.description: Victim’s Age Group

columns.name: VIC_RACE
columns.description: Victim’s Race Description

columns.name: VIC_SEX
columns.description: Victim’s Sex Description
